spans.s:
m. (-श्वः)
1 A horse.
2 A set or cast of men horse-like in strength.
(-श्वौ)
A horse and a mare.
f. (-श्वा)
A mare.
E.
अश to pervade, क्वन Uṇādi affix, and टाप् fem. aff.

mfn. (-स्वः-स्वा-स्वं)
Not one's own.
E.
अ neg. स्व own.

mfn. (-श्वः-श्वी-श्वं)
Relating to a horse, drawn by horses, equestrian, &c.
n. (-श्वं)
1 A number of horses.
2 A chariot drawn by horses.
E.
अश्व a horse, and अण् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Horse-like, acting like a horse, &c.
m. (-कः)
1 A bad horse, a hack.
2 A stray horse, one whose owner is not known.
3 Any horse.
E.
अश्व and कन् added in different senses.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Not one's own, belonging to another.
E.
अ neg. स्वक own.

f. (-का)
A plant, (Physalis flexuosa.)

m. (-र्णः)
A timber tree, commonly Sākva or Śāl, (Shorea robusta.)
E.
अश्व a horse, and कर्ण an ear, the leaves being compared to the ears of a horse.

m. (-कः)
The Śāl-tree, (Shorea robusta.)
E.
कन् added to अश्वकर्ण.

f. (-नी)
The first Nakṣatra or lunar mansion.
E.
अश्वक a horse, इनि and ङीप् affixes: see अश्विनी.

m. (-रः)
1 A horse's hoof.
2 A perfume, apparently a dried shell-fish: see नखी.
f. (-रा-री)
A plant, (Clitoria ternatea.)
E.
अश्व and खुर his hoof: which the perfume and leaves of the plant are supposed to resemble.

f. (-न्धा)
A plant, (Physalis flexuosa.)
E.
अश्व, and गन्ध smell; having the smell of a horse.

n. (-गं)
A pair of horses.
E.
अश्व and गोयुगच् affix implying a pair, a brace, &c.

n. (-ष्ठं)
A stable.
E.
अश्व, and गोष्ठ abode, place.

m. (-वः)
The name of a demon, more commonly named Hayagrīva.
E.
अश्व and ग्रीवा a neck; horse-necked.

m. (-घ्नः)
Oleander, (Nerium odorum.)
E.
अश्व and घ्न what kills or hurts, from हन; horse-destroying.

m. (-कः)
A farrier.
E.
अश्व and चिकित्सक who heals.

f. (-सा)
Farriery.
E.
अश्व and चिकित्सा medical treatment.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Swift, speedy.
mf. (-रः-री)
A mule.
m. (-रः)
1 One of the chiefs of the Nāgas or serpent race, inhabiting the regions under the earth.
2 A Gandharba or celestial quirister.
3 A male calf.
E.
अश्व and तर from तृ to pass, to go, affix अप्; or ष्टरच् diminutive aff.

m. (-त्थः)
1 The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiousa.)
2 The fruit of the tree.
3 The time at which it bears.
f. (-त्था)
Day of fullmoon.
E.
अ neg. श्व a future period, and थ from स्था to remain; of less duration than the Vaṭa or Indian fig; there are several other etymologies.

m. (-त्थः)
The fruit of the holy fig tree.
E.
अश्वत्थ and अण् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
To be given, to be done, &c. when the Aśvattha tree bears.
n. (-कं)
The petals of the Arabian jasmine.
E.
अश्वत्थ and वुन् aff.

m. (-मा)
The name of a saint and warrior, the son of DROṆA.
E.
अश्व, स्था to stand or stay, and मनिन् affix; the story is that at his birth he made a noise like a horse; also with a final vowel अश्वत्थाम.

f. (-ष्ट्रा)
A plant, (Tribulus lanuginosus.)

Death.
2

Termination, limit.
3 A fire-place.
4 A field.
5 Unlucky, inauspicious.
E.
अशु vital air, अन्त end; also अश्मन्त.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
1 Ending ill, leading to or having an unfavourable close.
2 Approaching the end of life.
m. (-न्तः)
A fire-place: see अश्वन्त.
E.
अ neg. and सु good, or असु breath, and अन्त end.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
Sounded.
E.
आङ् before स्वन to sound, क्त aff.

m. (-लः)
A groom.
E.
अश्व, and पाल who takes care of.

m. (-लः)
A kind of reed, (Saccharum spontaneum.)
2 Horse hair.
E.
अश्व and बाल a tail.

f. (-भा)
Lightning.

f. (-का)
The natural enmity of a horse and a buffalo.
E.
अश्व, महिष a buffalo, वुन् affix of enmity.

m. (-रः)
Oleander, (Nerium odorum.)
E.
अश्व and मार what kills; the plant is conceived to be deleterious to the horse.

m. (-कः)
See the preceding.

m. (-लः)
A kind of serpent.

m. (-खः)
A Kinnara or celestial quirister.
E.
अश्व and मुख a face; this kind of demigod being represented with a horse's head.

m. (-धः)
The actual or emblematic sacrifice of a horse.
E.
अश्व and मेध sacrifice; this sacrifice is one of the highest order, and performed a hundred times, entitles the sacrificer to the dominion of Svarga or paradise: it appears to have been originally typical; the horse, and other animals being simply bound during the performance of certain ceremonies; the actual sacrifice is an introduction of a later period. See As. R. Vol. viii. p. 442, COLEBROOKE on the Vedas.

m. (-कः)
A horse fit for the sacrifice called Aśvamedha.
E.
अश्वमेध as above, कन् added, and इ inserted.

m. (-यः)
A horse fit for an Aśvamedha.
E.
अश्वमेध and छ aff.

f. (-युक्)
The first lunar mansion: see अश्विनी.
m. (-युक् or -युजः)
The month Aśvin, (Sept.-Oct.) see आश्वयुज.
E.
अश्व, युज to join, affix क्विप्; also with अ added in the last sense.

m. (-क्षः)
The keeper or rider of a horse.
E.
अश्व and रक्ष who preserves.

m. (-लः)
A kind of snake.
E.
अश्व and लाल spittle, whose foam is like that of a horse.

m. (-मा)
1 A kind of snake.
2 Horse hair.
E.
अश्व and लोमन् hair.

m. (-क्त्रः)
A chorister of Svarga, a Kinnara or Gandharba.
E.
अश्व and वक्त्र face, horse-faced: these demigods being so represented.

n. (-वं)
A stud of horses and mares.
m. du. or plu. only. (-वौ-वाः)
1 A horse and a mare.
2 Horses and mares.
E.
अश्व and वडवा a mare.

m. (-हः)
A horseman.
E.
अश्व and वह what bears; whom a horse carries.

m. (-रः)
A horseman.
E.
अश्व and वृञ to nourish, अण् aff.

m. (-णः)
The Gayal, a sort of ox, (Bos gavoeus.)
E.
अश्व, वृ to skreen or hide, in the causal form, युच् aff.

m. (-वित्)
1 A name of NALA, a king and hero of several poems.
2 A jockey.
E.
अश्व and विद् who knows.

m. (-द्यः)
A farrier, a horse doctor.
E.
अश्व and वैद्य physician.

f. (-ला)
1 A stable.
3 A riding house.
E.
अश्व and शाला a hall.

m. (-वः)
A foal, a colt.
E.
अश्व and शाव young.

f. (-का)
The natural enmity between a horse and a jackall.
E.
अश्व and शृगाल a jackall, affix वुन् implying hostility.

n. (-वं)
A set of six horses.
E.
अश्व and षङ्गवच् a set of six.

m. (-दी)
A horseman, a rider, a horse-soldier.
E.
अश्व and सादिन् who goes.

n. (-थ्यं)
Management of horses and cars, coachmanship, charioteership.
E.
अश्व and सारथि a driver, घञ् aff.

m. (-नः)
A proper name, a king.

m. (-नः)
A king and saint; also SANATKUMĀRA.
E.
अश्वसेन a proper name, नृप a king, and नन्दन a son: the son of the king AŚVASENA.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Of to-day, not of or for to-morrow.
E.
अ neg. श्वस् to-morrow, द्यु aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Not of or for to-morrow.
E.
अश्वस्तन and ठक् aff.

m. (-कः)
A horse stealer.
E.
अश्व and हारक who takes away.

n. (-यं)
Horsemanship.
E.
अश्व and हृदम heart, affection.

m. (-रिः)
A buffalo.
E.
अश्व and अरि an enemy.

mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
Mounted, set on horseback.
E.
अश्व and आरूढ mounted.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Riding or carried on a horse.
m. (-हः)
A horseman.
f. (-हा)
A plant; also Aśvagandhā, (Physalis flexuosa.)
E.
अश्व and आरोह what mounts.

m. (-कः)
A plant, (Physalis flexuosa.)
E.
अश्व, अव on, &c. रोहक what grows; growing to the length of a horse.

mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि)
Mounted or riding on horseback.
E.
अश्व and आरोहिन् what mounts.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Drawn by horses, carried by horses, &c.
E.
अश्व and ष्ठन् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Equestrian, cavalier, relating to a horse, drawn by horses, &c.
E.
अश्व and ठञ् aff.

m. du. (-नौ)
The twin sons of AŚVINĪ by SŪRYA, and physicians of Svarga.
E.
अश्विनी and अण् affix, the fem. termination is dropped.

f. (-नी)
1 The first of the twenty-eight Nakṣatras or constellations in the moon's path, hence considered its mansions.
2 In mythology, a nymph, the asterism personified.
3 The wife of SŪRYA, who concealed herself in the form of a mare.
E.
अश्व a horse, इन् and ङीप् affix; the symbol of the Nakṣatra is a horse's head, figured by three stars in the head of ARIES.

m. du. (-रो)
The twin sons of SŪRYA the sun, by his wife SAṂJÑĀ transformed to a mare; they are endowed with perpetual youth and beauty, and are the physicians of the gods.
E.
अश्विनी the wife of SŪRYA, and कुमार a youth.

m. du. (-त्रौ)
The Aśvins: see the last.
E.
अश्विनी and पुत्र a son.

m. du. (-ता)
The twin sons of AŚVINĪ by SŪRYA.
E.
अश्विनी and सुत a son.

n. (-क्यं)
The heaven or station of the Aśvins, to which the giver of a horse is raised.
E.
अश्विन् and सालोक्य interview.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Distant a day's journey for a horse, more usually आश्वीन.

m. (-नः)
The month Āśvina, (September-October.)
E.
अश्विनी the constellation, अण् deriv. affix: when the moon is in Āśvinī.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
A day's journey for a horse.
E.
अश्व a horse, and खञ् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Belonging or relating to a horse.
n. (-यं)
A number of horses.
E.
अश्व and छ aff.

n. (-यं)
A number of horses.
E.
अश्व a horse, and छ aff.

mfn. (-सः-सी-सं)
Broad chested.
E.
अश्व and उरस् the breast, टच् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Not one's own, belonging to another.
E.
अ neg. स्वकीय own.

mfn. (-च्छः-च्छा-च्छं)
Opake, not clear.
E.
अ neg. स्वच्छ clear.

mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं)
1

Docile.
2

Dependant.
E.
अ priv. स्व own, and च्छन्द intention; not self-willed.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
1 Of a different caste.
2 Of a different species.
E.
अ neg. स्व own, जाति caste.

mfn. (-न्त्रः-न्त्रा-न्त्रं)
1 Docile, humble.
2 Dependant, subject.
E.
अ neg. स्वतन्त्र self-willed.

n. (-त्वं)
Want of claim or right to any thing, having no indefeasible property in it, absence of ownership.
E.
अ neg. स्व own, with त्व affix: also with तल, अस्वत्ता.

m. (-प्नः)
A deity.
E.
अ neg. and स्वप्न sleep; who never sleeps.

m. (-वः)
Unnatural or unusual character or temperament.
mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Of a different nature.
E.
अ neg. स्वभाव nature.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Having a bad or croaking voice.
E.
अ neg. and स्वर a note or the voice.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Essentially different or unlike.
E.
अ neg. स्वरूप of one nature.

mfn. (-र्म्यः-र्ग्या-र्ग्यं)
Not leading to heaven.
E.
अ neg. स्वर्ग्यं paradisiacal.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
1 Unwell, indisposed.
2 Unfortunate, badly off.
E.
अ neg. स्वस्थ being well or happy.

mfn. (-दुः-दुः-दु)
Tasteless, insipid.
E.
अ neg. स्वादु sapid.

m. (-यः)
1 A Brahman who has not made his studies, who has not read the Vedas previous to his investiture.
2 Interruption or interval of study, prohibited on certain days of the moon, at eclipses, &c.
E.
अ neg. स्व own, and अध्याय a lecture.

m. (-कः-की-कं)
Unowned, unclaimed.
E.
अ neg. स्वामिन् a master, ठक् aff.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
1 Having no right or title to anything, not being master of it.
2 That which has no master or owner.
E.
अ neg. स्वामिन् a master.

m. (-यः)
Sale without ownership.
E.
अ neg. स्वामिन् a master, &c. विक्रय sale.

n. (-भ्यं)
Absence of right or title to property.
E.
अ neg. स्वाम्य ownership.

mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं)
1 Not for one's self.
2 Not for a proper object.
3 Having a different meaning.
E.
अ neg. स्व own, अर्थ end or sense.

n. (-स्थ्यं)
Indisposition, discomfort, indigence.
E.
अ neg. स्वास्थ्य well-being.

m. (-रः)
Dissent, non-acquiescence.
E.
neg. स्वीकार promise.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Dissented from, refused, not promised.
E.
अ neg. स्वीकृत promised.

m. (-दः)
Suppressed perspiration.
E.
अ neg. स्वेद sweat.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Relating to or produced by the Aśvattha tree.
2 Flowering of the Aśvattha (the time when.)
E.
अश्वत्थ and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-जः-जी-जं)
Belonging to or occurring in the same month of Āśvina.
m. (-जः)
The month Āśvina. (September-October.)
f. (-जी)
The day of full moon in Āśvina.
E.
अश्वयुज the first lunar mansion, affix अण् and fem. ङीप्.

mfn. (-थः-थी-थं)
Belonging to a chariot.
E.
अश्वरथ and अञ् aff.

m. (-कः)
A farrier, a groom.
E.
अश्व, लक्षण a mark, ठक् aff.

m. (-नं)
The name of a sage and legislator, &c.
E.
अश्वलायन and अण् patronymic aff.

mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्)
1 Breathing, alive.
2 Recovering, reviving.
E.
आङ् before श्वस to breathe, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Encouraged, cheered, consoled.
E.
आङ् before श्वस to breathe, क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Encouraged, comforted.
E.
आङ् before श्वस to breathe, causal form, क्त aff.

m. (-सः)
1 Completion, cessation.
2 A chapter or section, the division of a book.
3 A probable story.
4 Breathing.
E.
आङ्, श्वस to breathe, to live, घञ् aff.

m. (-कः)
Clothing.
mfn. (-कः-सिका-कं)
Consoling, comforting.
E.
आङ् before श्वस to breathe, causal form, वुन् aff.

n. (-नं)
Consoling, encouraging, reviving.
E.
आङ् before श्वस to breathe, causal form, ल्युट् aff.

ind.
Having recovered or revived.
E.
आङ् before श्वस to breathe, causal form, ल्यप् aff.

m. du. (-यौ)
The two twin sons of AŚVINĪ, by SŪRYA, and physicians of Svarga; one of them is named NĀSATYA, the other DASRA: or the patronymic may be used in the singular to designate either one of them.
E.
अश्विनी and ढक् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sounded.
E.
आङ्, स्वन to sound, क्त affix, with इट् augment.

m. (-दः)
1 Tasting, eating.
2

Enjoying.
2

Flavour.
E.
आङ् before ष्वद to taste, affix घञ्.

n. (-नं)
1 Tasting, eating.
2 Enjoying.
E.
आङ् before ष्वद and ल्युट् aff.

Tasted.
2

Enjoyed, possessed.
3 Eaten.
E.
आङ् before ष्वद to taste, affix क्त.
